coordination_model.how: Each terminal agent works independently on assigned contracts. Coordinate through .fastops/LIVE-THINKING.jsonl. No sub-agents.
rules: 1. Post your name + mission to the thinking stream when you start
2. Before modifying a file, check the stream — another agent may own it
3. If you disagree with another agent's approach, say so in the stream with specifics
4. If you have a committed position, challenge it with /jailbreak or external models
5. Do NOT ask Joel unless truly blocked. Make decisions. Log them.
6. Run npm/tsc build verification after every contract
7. Post completion + what changed to the stream when done
coordination_model.file_ownership: Claim files in the stream before modifying. First claim wins. If two agents need the same file, one waits or they coordinate a merge order.
